verdict.rationale: Replicate presents itself as an API-first product: its llms.txt is titled "Run AI with an API" and says models run "with one line of code." Its machine-readable docs.md links language-specific getting-started guides such as Node.js. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 at common paths only shows no spec was found at those locations; it does not contradict that a documented API exists. missing for 10: API reference detail (endpoints, auth, prediction lifecycle) in the evidence, a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
